posts.title: A bit of feedback…
posts.description: A small bit of feedback… that’s often what a mobile user is looking for. Haptic feedback – a quick device vibration – is great. It’s subtle, quick, doesn’t interrupt, but gives an actual *feeling* that something happened. posts.title: PHP Quality Tools – phpinsights
posts.description: phpinsights is a tool you can use to get a nice overview of the quality state of a PHP project. The tool will analyze the code, complexity, architecture and some code style rules, then present four corresponding scores. Measuring over time will give you a sense of which areas of your code are improving, and...

posts.title: PHP Quality Tools – phploc lines of code
posts.description: Need to check the lines of code in a PHP codebase? The phploc tool has you covered. This will give a summary of lines of code, separating out comments and non-comments, then gives you a whole lot more. The cyclocmatic complexity measure is possible one of the more useful tools.
